body.html: Search and digital marketing engagements Teknoppy has run for clients in Kerala, Qatar and the UAE. Unlike the rest of this portfolio, these projects are judged on numbers rather than screens, so each card leads straight to the full write-up with its rankings, traffic and enquiry figures.

sections.intro: The services these engagements draw on, each with its own page.

items.title: SEO Services
items.text: Technical, on-page and content SEO on live sites, reported against rankings and organic traffic.

items.title: Local SEO
items.text: Google Business Profile work, local landing pages and citation cleanup for businesses selling in a defined area.

items.title: Ecommerce SEO
items.text: Category and product-page search work on live stores.

items.title: Digital Marketing
items.text: Social, content and paid campaigns run alongside search rather than in place of it.

items.title: Website Speed Optimization
items.text: Core Web Vitals work, usually the first fix on a site whose rankings are held back by performance.

items.title: UX Audit
items.text: Where traffic arrives but does not convert, an audit of the pages it lands on.

paragraphs.html: Most of these began as SEO engagements on a site someone else had built, which usually means the first month is technical cleanup rather than content. Where the business sells in a defined area, local SEO and Google Business Profile work carried more weight than national rankings.
Full numbers for every engagement are on Case Studies. For design and build work, see the rest of the portfolio.

items.q: Do these case studies include real numbers?
items.a: Yes. Each engagement above links to a full write-up with its ranking, traffic and enquiry figures.
items.aHtml: Yes. Each engagement above links to a full write-up on Case Studies with its ranking, traffic and enquiry figures.

items.q: Do you do SEO on sites you didn't build?
items.a: Yes. Most of the engagements above started on an existing site built by someone else.

items.q: Is digital marketing run separately from SEO?
items.a: They are separate services but usually run together — the social and campaign work above sat alongside search on the same accounts.
items.aHtml: They are separate services but usually run together — the digital marketing work above sat alongside search on the same accounts.
